title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory catches AI-generated tests that could never fail and turns the result into local, reviewable evidence through Unified Graph Ops, including Mermaid diagrams for bounded proof paths. Existing assurance includes LangGraph resume parity and the Gauntlet Survival Card. Version 0.44.0 adds First Proof: one command runs a sealed sandbox demonstration, confirms a healthy positive control, catches an intentionally hollow negative control as HOLLOW_E2E_TEST, and writes a privacy-safe Proof Card. Local opt-in adoption milestones make activation measurable without transmitting identity or mistaking downloads for users. The release also starts a 21-day adoption sprint and a voluntary ten-repository Proof Clinic. Release media retains the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: First Proof is a demonstration, not an assessment of the user's project. Proof Cards summarize one verified receipt and exclude commands, paths, repository names, prompts, logs, and identity. They do not certify production readiness, security, coverage, identity, or release authority.
